welcome.title: Welcome to {name}
welcome.text: Let's set things up the way you like them. This takes about thirty seconds, and you can change any of it later in Settings.

theme.title: Pick your look
theme.text: This one's just for you — it won't change what anyone else sees.

accent.title: Choose an accent
accent.text: Buttons, highlights and progress bars use this.
accent.admin: As an admin, this sets it for the whole server. People can pick their own in Settings if you allow it (Admin → Playback).
accent.personal: It's just for you; change it any time in Settings.

interests.title: What are you here for?
interests.text: We'll show these on your shelf and hide the rest. Pick as many as you like.
interests.pickOne: Pick at least one so your shelf isn't empty.

security.title: Protect your account
security.text: Optional. Two-factor asks for a code from your phone when you sign in, so a password alone isn't enough. You can turn it on now or later in Settings → Security.

done.title: You're all set
done.everything: Your shelf is showing everything. Dive in.
done.tuned: Your shelf is tuned to {list}. You can add more any time from Settings.
